items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Marcello, yeah. Oh yeah, I knew him.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, Cordella came back there.
Did you know Joe Marcello around New York? Marcello, yeah. Oh yeah, I knew him.
Oh yeah. He worked in the Hickory House for a long time. Common master played guitar with him for a good while.
